accepted.condition: Support only if the amendment also requires ending billionaire giveaways, curbing presidential corruption and profiteering, and requiring ICE to comply with the Constitution.
accepted.quote: I will only support a constitutional amendment compelling Republicans to finally balance a budget if it also compels them to stop throwing money at billionaires, to crack down on record corruption and profit-taking by their incorrigible President
